table.retrieve:
SELECT  
		Saleinvcode=(select count(saleinvcode) 
				from saleledger 
				where 
					SaleInvCode Between :ar_SinvCode AND :ar_LinvCode AND
					(Posted = Case :ar_postedunposted 
					 WHEN 'B' THEN 'Y'
					 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
	  				 WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
		  			 ELSE 'Z'
					 END OR
					Posted = Case :ar_postedunposted 
					 WHEN 'B' THEN 'N'
					 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
		  			 WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
		  			 ELSE 'Z'
					 END) AND
				SalesManCode IN (:ar_usercode)), 
		SD.ICode, 
		SD.Batch, 
		Item = I.Name,
		SalePrice=MAX(I.SalePrice),
		Packing=MAX(I.packingdesc),
		SUM(SD.looseQty) AS Qty, 
		SUM(SD.BonusQty) AS Bonus,
		SaleValue=SUM(SD.looseQty * (SD.SalePrice - ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) *
			(1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
		Manufacturer = CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 1 THEN ICT.Name WHEN 2 THEN M.Name ELSE IC.Name END

FROM
		Saledetail SD,
		SaleLedger SL,
		Manufacturer M,
		ItemCategory ICT,
		ItemClass IC,
		Item	I
WHERE 
		SL.SaleInvCode Between :ar_SinvCode AND :ar_LinvCode AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode AND
		SL.SalesManCode IN (:ar_UserCode) AND
		(SL.Posted = Case :ar_postedunposted 
						 WHEN 'B' THEN 'Y'
						 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
			  			 WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
			  			 ELSE 'Z'
						 END OR
		SL.Posted = Case :ar_postedunposted 
						 WHEN 'B' THEN 'N'
						 WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
			  			 WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
			  			 ELSE 'Z'
						 END) AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
		I.ICatCode = ICT.ICatCode AND
		I.ICCode = IC.ICCode
GROUP BY
		SD.ICode, 
		SD.Batch, 
		M.Name,
		ICT.Name,
		IC.Name,
		I.Name

ORDER BY
		Manufacturer,
		I.Name

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: case( ar_postedunposted when 'B' then 'Both Posted AND Un-Posted' when 'Y' then 'Posted Only' when 'N' then 'Unposted Only' ELSE 'Neigther Posted Nor Un-Posted')
